english.note: Choose this when the aversion is mainly a feeling of dislike or repugnance toward something.
Use this for strong emotional aversion, such as being allergic to homework in the figurative sense.
Choose this when the discomfort is specifically disgust or offense rather than general unease.

examples.english: I am averse to the smell of cigarette smoke.
